Class Position

java.lang.Object
utils.Position
public class Position extends Object
Represents a zero-indexed coordinate (row, column) on the 8x8 chessboard and provides conversion utilities for standard algebraic notation (e.g., "E2"). Row 0 corresponds to Rank 8 (top), and Row 7 corresponds to Rank 1 (bottom). Column 0 corresponds to File A (left), and Column 7 corresponds to File H (right).

    • fromAlgebraic

      public static Position fromAlgebraic(String notation)
      Constructs a Position from standard two-character chess notation (e.g., "E2").
      Parameters:
      notation - a two-character string where the first character is the file ('A'-'H') and the second character is the rank ('1'-'8')
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the notation is null, improperly formatted, or out of bounds
